name: Hermey
subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
description: Native client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent. Every bot (Hermes profile) is reachable through one gateway; approvals, streaming replies and tool output appear in the conversation. Builds are unsigned and must be re-signed by your sideloading app.

apps.name: Hermey
apps.subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
apps.localizedDescription: Chats with every Hermes bot, streaming replies, tool cards, inline approvals and per-device pairing.

versions.localizedDescription:
– Three feeds from one measurement, an iOS notifier that never gates, and Sparkle on macOS
– A bot's message to another bot is drawn as prose, not as markdown source
– Eyes act per activity, and the spinning ring is gone
– Rakazo's own frame model, and macOS banners wear the bot
– The reference motion model belongs inside BotAvatarMotion
– The transcript stops animating, idle draws at a third of the beat, and offscreen faces rest
– A chat you left a minute ago is answered from cache, not resumed again
– The cache freshness is an instance seam, and the old test now says the new truth
– Name the type, not `Self`, in the stored freshness default
– Working moves, and small faces exaggerate their gaze
– Both update prompts carry release notes, generated from the release's own commits

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the pairing code shown by your Hermes host to connect this device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hermes connects to your own Hermes host over your private network.
